name: bug fixes
desc:
is honor truly dead

pc keybinds
x to bow or sheath
b to pray
e, q, f for directional cuts
r to change stance
= to take off hat
g to displace

console keybinds (ps/xbox)
2x dpadleft = pray
2x dpadright = bow
dpaddown = change stance
triangle/Y = sheathe/displace
square/X = atk left
circle/B = atk right
cross/A = atk down
L3 = shiftlock
